title: Outeniqua Transport Museum

terrainReference.basis: Unchanged terrain at the center of the named museum envelope.

mapIdentity.scope: Current OSM way 172467203 directly names the museum and supplies the large angled exterior envelope, with several shallow notches and additions. The geographic target uses the outline center rather than the nearby Qualla point.

note: The cleared Qualla view establishes ribbed cool-gray corrugated walls and the upper rail-side edge. Transnet documents a brick museum section and public entrance; their position is matched approximately to the mapped east-end entrance. The municipal footprint separates the main 153.56 × 95.379 m shed and small west returns. Three shallow parallel steel roofs are a reconstruction based on span and railway layout; no surveyed roof section was available.
